title: Hydroponics for Growing Healthy Salad Greens
description: What you will learn Choose the Best Salad greens for Singapore’s climate that are delicious and healthy  (e.g. right varieties of lettuce, kale…and many others) Using Sunlight to keep your cost low in hydroponics No soil, no mess – just clean, fast, space-saving growing Understand Safety in Hydroponics – we teach you how to identify safe materials to use in hydropoics Plant, Grow, and Harvest with confidence—learn when to sow, how to water, and when to harvest for maximum flavor and nutrition. Grow in Small Spaces using our techniques, ideal for balconies, HDB flats, condominium .  Techniques also applies to landed property What's Included 25 Comprehensive Video Lessons covering every stage of your hydroponics salad greens journey. Total Duration is 2 Hours.  Access anytime , anywhere for the entire 1 year Downloadable Slides, Guides & Checklists so you can follow along easily even at the end of the course. Early Bird BONUS #1  GrowThrive Hydroponics Kit (include all you need to start hydroponics at home) Worth SG$45 (only during promo period) Early Bird BONUS #2 FREE One year one-to-one support from Expert Training Team (You can ask them questions and they support you to grow salad greens using hydroponics!)
